app-restorewarningtoast.description: Surfaces partial history loss after a restore (I6): some key-backup blobs were present but couldn't be decrypted (corrupt/undecryptable), so those conversations' history won't appear on this device. Shown once per session rather than failing the whole login — one bad blob must not block recovering everything else.

reactDocgen.description:
Surfaces partial history loss after a restore (I6): some key-backup
blobs were present but couldn't be decrypted (corrupt/undecryptable),
so those conversations' history won't appear on this device. Shown
once per session rather than failing the whole login — one bad blob
must not block recovering everything else.

feedback-statuscover.description: Full-width centred cover shown while a long-running on-device crypto step is in progress (Argon2id derivation, key rotation, account teardown). Konsta `Preloader` is the single "work in progress" spinner across the app (ADR-0023 T3) — it replaced the bespoke three-pulsing-dots so every such moment looks the same on iOS and Material.

reactDocgen.description:
Full-width centred cover shown while a long-running on-device crypto step is
in progress (Argon2id derivation, key rotation, account teardown). Konsta
`Preloader` is the single "work in progress" spinner across the app (ADR-0023
T3) — it replaced the bespoke three-pulsing-dots so every such moment looks
the same on iOS and Material.

destructive.description:
Tints the spinner red for destructive operations (account deletion).
Default is the primary-coloured spinner used by every other long-running
crypto step (register / login derive, password change).
